block.guhs.ertskarretje.lore: Deco from Conducteur Piepwiel. Right-click to sit in it. Choo choo... it doesn't ride, guhtje.
block.guhs.kegeltje.lore: A plush guh pin from De Guhde. It doesn't fall over here. Piep!
block.guhs.seinlampje.lore: Red over green. Gives light, never gives a ticket.
block.guhs.stationsklokje.lore: It always says five past guh.
block.guhs.wolbalrek.lore: Three wool balls, ready to roll.
gui.guhs.kegelen.kijk: Look down the lane, at the pins!
gui.guhs.kegelen.sta: Stand on the approach of your lane!
gui.guhs.kegelen.strike_sub: All ten pins! Piep piep piep!
gui.guhs.mijnspellen.niet_bouwen: Njeg, this cave is a game hall: no building or digging here!
gui.guhs.spelgroep.karretjes.waar: Under a little station hut somewhere in the Guhmension: down with the Wolkenliftje to the Switch Cave, with Conducteur Piepwiel on the balcony.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.kegelen.waar: Under a little hut with a giant pin on its roof somewhere in the Guhmension: down with the Wolkenliftje, De Guhde is behind the counter.
item.guhs.kegelgrot_wolbal_leen.leen: On loan: back to De Guhde after the game.
item.guhs.kegelgrot_wolbal_leen.lore: Look where it should go, hold right-click for power, let go to bowl. Stand left or right for a little hook; sneak for a straight ball.
quest.guhs.karretjes.bezig: %s is on shift right now. Watch from the balcony, it's quite exciting!
quest.guhs.karretjes.bezig_jij: You're on shift! %s right, %s gone. Keep your paws on the levers!
quest.guhs.karretjes.eerste_record: Your first shift on this track: %s carts. That's your record now!
quest.guhs.karretjes.geen_record: Your record on this track stays %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.gestopt: Shift over! The carts go back to the depot.
quest.guhs.karretjes.grot_record: The best shift of the whole world on this track! Your name is on the board.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo1: Tuut tuut! Conducteur Piepwiel here. The ore carts are waiting, and so are the bins. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo2: Welcome to the Switch Cave! Every cart in the right bin, and no derailing... we don't even have that. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo3: Psst. The coal cart once ended up in the vads bin. The vads tasted of soot for a week. Njeg! Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hallo4: All aboard! Well, not you. The ore. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.karretjes.hoe: Levers on the railing: on = right, off = left. Every cart in the bin of its ore!
quest.guhs.karretjes.kapot: Njeg... I can't find my rails. This cave isn't quite right.
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_aardig: Not bad! Next time a bit quicker on the levers.
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_goed: Very good! The ore thanks you, and so do I.
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_oefenen: The coal got mixed up with the vads again... practice makes perfect, guhtje!
quest.guhs.karretjes.oordeel_top: Phew! I've never seen anything like it. Want my cap? (No. Buy one. Njeg.)
quest.guhs.karretjes.start_lastig: Track 3! Five switches, six bins. Even I get dizzy. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.karretjes.start_makkelijk: Track 1! Two switches, three bins. Tuut tuut, here they come...
quest.guhs.karretjes.start_medium: Track 2! Three switches, four bins. Mind the gold, it's shy.
quest.guhs.karretjes.te_lang: That was a very long shift! Time for a nap, guhtje.
quest.guhs.karretjes.telling: Shift over: %s carts in the right bin (%s).
quest.guhs.karretjes.tien1: %s carts right! You're a natural, guhtje.
quest.guhs.karretjes.tien2: %s! The bins are getting full. Njeg!
quest.guhs.karretjes.tien3: %s! Shall I make you head conductor?
quest.guhs.karretjes.uitleg: The carts roll out of the tunnel, each full of one ore: the colour of its load says which bin it belongs in (the ore is also in the wall behind its bin). On the railing there is a lever above every switch: on = right, off = left; the rail shows where the switch sends the next cart. A cart in the wrong bin is gone; %s gone and your shift is over. They come ever faster, guhtje!
quest.guhs.karretjes.weggelopen: You left your post... the carts stopped by themselves.
quest.guhs.kegelen.bezig: %s is bowling now. Grab a seat, have a kaasknabbel.
quest.guhs.kegelen.bezig_jij: You're at %s points, man. Keep rolling.
quest.guhs.kegelen.eerste_record: Your first game on this lane: %s points. That's your record now!
quest.guhs.kegelen.geen_record: Your record on this lane stays %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.gestopt: Game over, man. The ball goes back on the rack.
quest.guhs.kegelen.grot_record: The best game of the whole world on this lane! Your name is on the board.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo1: Hey, guh. The Guhde abides. Fancy a game? Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo2: That rug really tied the cave together, you know. Bowl a game? Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo3: The pins squeak when they fall. Don't worry, they like it. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hallo4: Strike! Oh, wait, I'm just practising saying it. Your best: %s / %s / %s.
quest.guhs.kegelen.hoe: Look at the pins, hold right-click, let go. Left or right of the middle = a hook; sneak = straight.
quest.guhs.kegelen.kapot: Njeg... the lanes are gone? That's... not cool, man.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_aardig: Not bad! A little more hook next time.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_goed: Nice game, man. The pins will talk about it for days.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_oefenen: The gutters say thank you. Practice, guh, practice.
quest.guhs.kegelen.oordeel_top: Whoa. That was... like, the best thing I've seen in this cave. Respect, guh.
quest.guhs.kegelen.start_lastig: The obstacle lane. Two posts and a Mika who won't sit still. Good luck, guh.
quest.guhs.kegelen.start_makkelijk: The straight lane. Mind the gutters, they're hungry.
quest.guhs.kegelen.start_medium: The bendy lane! Bounce off the bumpers, it's allowed.
quest.guhs.kegelen.strike1: STRIKE! The pins squeak for joy!
quest.guhs.kegelen.te_lang: The ball got cold, man. Another time!
quest.guhs.kegelen.uitleg: Ten frames, two balls each (a strike: all ten with the first ball, a spare: all ten with two). A strike counts 10 + your next two balls, a spare 10 + the next one; in the 10th frame you get bonus balls. Look where the ball should go, hold right-click for power and let go. Stand left or right on the approach and it hooks towards the middle; sneak for a straight ball.
quest.guhs.kegelen.vol: Your paws are full! Make room for the ball first.
quest.guhs.kegelen.weggelopen: You walked off the approach... the pins went to sleep.
structure.guhs.karretjeswissels.tooltip: Cave minigame: sort the ore carts with the switches, ertsbonnetjes and a conductor's cap
structure.guhs.kegelgrot.tooltip: Cave minigame: guh bowling with De Guhde, kegelknopen and a bowling outfit
